S: Bones should have left Chili's leather jacket alone

Crisp crumbed ham croquettes with a creamy centre, a Little Havana bakery classic. Melt 60g butter, cook 80g flour for 1 minute and whisk in 500ml milk until very thick. Stir in 200g finely chopped ham and nutmeg, chill 3 hours. Shape 20 logs, roll in egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 180C until golden.
the studio meetings Chili talks his way into
Baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and baby cos with green goddess: blitz mayo, sour cream, parsley, tarragon, chives, anchovy and lemon.
Chili's Miami, before he heads out to LA
Puff pastry squares filled with guava paste and cream cheese, brushed with egg, baked at 200C for 18 minutes and dusted with sugar while hot.
K: Chili showing a movie star how to stare a man down

45ml vodka, 120ml tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire, hot sauce, celery salt and pepper, rolled between tins, celery stick. For each drink, put 45ml vodka, 120ml tomato juice, 10ml lemon juice, 2 dashes Worcestershire sauce, 2 dashes hot sauce and a pinch each of celery salt and pepper in a tin with ice. Pour back and forth between two tins 5 times, strain over fresh ice and add a celery stick. Makes four.
Get Shorty (1995).P: Serve the mains when Chili starts pitching his movie idea.

S: Primo's kitchen, every grain treated with respect
Chilled saffron risotto rolled around mozzarella and peas, floured, egged and crumbed, fried at 175C until deep gold.
red, white and green, the tricolore from the big night
One base risotto split three ways: tomato and basil, parmesan and butter, and pea and mint purée. Serve side by side in one shallow bowl.
the opening course of the big night
Marinated eggplant, peeled roast capsicum, artichoke hearts, olives and thick-cut provolone, with rocket dressed in lemon and oil and warm bread to mop up.

M: thirty days, thirty million, and even the chicken is gilded
Buttermilk fried chicken thighs brushed with hot honey butter and finished with edible gold leaf, on buttery mash.
Eye fillet seared to medium rare, half a lobster tail grilled with garlic butter, béarnaise.
flambéed tableside, like the opening night
Flatten scotch fillet, sear hot, set aside. Shallot and garlic in butter, flame with brandy, add Dijon, Worcestershire, stock and cream, reduce, steak back in.
carved to order on opening night, black tie
Rib roast salted overnight and roasted pink, carved thick with its own jus, horseradish and popovers straight from a hot tin.
Dry-brine rib eye on a rack overnight. Sear in a smoking pan, baste with butter, thyme and garlic to 54C inside, rest 8 minutes. Creamed spinach on the side.
the graveyard shift special in the Tangiers coffee shop
Thick ham steaks off the griddle with two eggs any style and crisp hash browns.
Beef chuck browned, braised with onion, carrot, celery, tomato paste and stock for 2.5 hours, potatoes for the last hour. Crusty bread.
the all-night counter where Captain Bosch's men eat
Three-egg omelettes folded around ham, green capsicum and onion, with paprika home fries and rye toast.

S: something cool from the El Barrio kitchen before the dancing starts
Thick wedges of avocado and tomato over iceberg, lime-soaked red onion, olive oil and coriander.
Soak salt cod 24 hours, changing the water, flake. Whisk flour, baking powder, water, garlic and coriander into a loose batter, fold in the cod, fry flat spoonfuls at 180C until lacy.
Fry green plantain chunks at 160C until soft, smash flat, fry again at 190C. Salt and spoon over garlic, lime and olive oil mojo.

M: a long hot day on the block
Sticky barbecue chicken drumsticks off the grill with buttered corn on the cob and potato salad, eaten on the steps.
Friday on the block, hot from the market counter
Cornmeal-crusted catfish fried crisp on soft white bread with hot sauce slaw and pickles.

S: the pizza Kevin orders on his first night alone
Pizza dough rolled thin, topped with a quick tomato sauce and plenty of mozzarella, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 6 minutes, cut into small squares.
the paint cans swinging down the stairs
Popcorn tossed in melted butter and salt, half of it coated in red-tinted white chocolate, mixed together in clean paint tins.
W: the cookies left out for the house
Butter sugar cookies cut into stars and trees, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced white and green with silver cachous.
the giant sundae he builds watching a gangster film

Vanilla and chocolate ice cream with homemade hot fudge, salted caramel, whipped cream, crushed nuts, marshmallows, sprinkles and cherries to build your own. Heat 150ml cream with 150g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp golden syrup, stirring until glossy. Melt 100g brown sugar with 50g butter, add 100ml cream and a pinch of salt and simmer 2 minutes. Whip 300ml thickened cream. Set out 1L vanilla and 1L chocolate ice cream with the sauces, cream and bowls of 80g crushed peanuts, 100g mini marshmallows, sprinkles and cocktail cherries.

S: Mixed nuts and pumpkin seeds tossed with soy, a little honey and sesame, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes.
Edamame boiled 4 minutes in salted water, tossed with flaky salt and a drop of sesame oil.
W: the only flavour on Raymond's truck
Blend 400ml coconut cream, 200ml thickened cream and 120g sugar with toasted coconut, churn or still-freeze, stirring every hour.
Raymond's choc chip ice cream sandwiches
Raymond and his ice cream truck in the park

Soft brown butter choc chip cookies sandwiching vanilla ice cream, edges rolled in sprinkles and frozen firm. Brown 115g butter and cool. Beat with 100g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 190g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb and 120g choc chips. Roll 16 balls and bake at 180C for 9 minutes. Cool completely. Sandwich a scoop of vanilla ice cream between pairs, roll the edges in sprinkles and freeze for 1 hour.

S: the wall of fame watches you eat
Strips of pizza dough tied in knots, proved 30 minutes, baked at 230C for 12 minutes, tossed hot in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan.
the only cool thing on the block on the hottest day of the year

Ice-cold watermelon and salty feta on skewers with mint, finished with lime juice and a chilli salt sprinkle. Cut 1kg chilled seedless watermelon into 3cm cubes and 200g firm feta into 2cm cubes. Thread onto 16 skewers, alternating with small mint leaves. Mix 1 tsp flaky salt, half a tsp chilli flakes and the zest of 1 lime. Squeeze the lime juice over the skewers, sprinkle with the chilli salt and serve straight from the fridge.
W: for the heat on the block
Shave or crush ice into cups, soak with homemade cherry syrup: cherries simmered with sugar and lemon, strained.
for when the fire hydrant gets opened
Blend watermelon with lime juice and a little sugar syrup, strain, pour into moulds with sticks and freeze at least 6 hours.

S: Italian bread split and spread with butter mashed with garlic, parsley and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes until crisp at the edges.
the candlelit table set for Lady and Tramp
Salami and provolone folded on a board with olives, marinated artichoke and roasted capsicum, with torn bread.
W: Lady and Tramp's dinner at Tony's
Cannoli shells piped with ricotta whipped with icing sugar, orange zest and dark chocolate chips, the ends dipped in crushed pistachios.
Jim Dear's doughnuts with coffee caramel
Jim Dear dunking a doughnut at breakfast

Hot cinnamon sugar doughnuts made for dunking, with a silky coffee caramel dip, the breakfast Lady sits begging beside. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g sugar, 1 egg, 40g soft butter and 200ml warm milk into a dough, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll 1cm thick, cut 12 rings and prove 20 minutes. Fry at 175C for 1 minute a side and toss in 100g sugar with 2 tsp cinnamon. For the dip, melt 150g brown sugar with 50g butter, add 150ml cream and 1 tsp instant coffee and simmer 3 minutes.

S: green spinach and artichoke dip, corn chips for scooping
Wilt spinach, squeeze dry, chop with marinated artichokes, fold into cream cheese, sour cream, mozzarella and parmesan with garlic. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes until bubbling.
there's something in the fridge, and it isn't the eggs
Whip yolks with mayo, Dijon and a drop of green colouring, pipe back into whites, chives on top.
W: giant marshmallows, toasted until they melt down
Big marshmallow toasted, sandwiched between digestive biscuits with a square of milk chocolate. Under the grill for 30 seconds if there's no fire.
in honour of the big guy
Big marshmallows on skewers, toasted over a flame until the outside blisters. Dip in melted dark chocolate and crushed biscuits.

S: the scene where Carl makes his son a toastie
Thick white bread buttered on the outside, filled with sharp cheddar, gruyère and a little parmesan, cooked slowly in a pan over low heat, lid on, until the cheese pours, cut on the diagonal.
Yuca peeled, boiled 20 minutes until tender, cut into batons, fried at 185C until crisp, salted, with a garlic and lime mojo.
W: the dessert the critic tears apart, done right
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked into eggs and sugar, a little flour folded in, baked in buttered ramekins at 220C for 9 minutes so the centre runs.
New Orleans beignets with chicory café
the road trip stop in New Orleans

Pillowy yeasted squares fried until puffed and golden, buried under icing sugar, with a jug of hot café au lait for dunking. Mix 7g yeast, 50g sugar and 180ml warm water, then add 80ml evaporated milk, 1 egg, 30g melted butter and 400g plain flour. Knead briefly, cover and chill overnight. Roll to 5mm, cut into 6cm squares and rest 20 minutes. Fry at 180C for 1 minute a side until puffed. Bury in 100g icing sugar. Serve with 500ml strong coffee mixed with 500ml hot milk.
